key_fields.name: TRNX-KEY
key_fields.meaning: 32-byte composite key: card number followed by transaction id; matches the TRNXFILE record key FD-TRNXS-ID in CBSTM03B, so records are ordered by card number.

key_fields.name: TRNX-CARD-NUM
key_fields.meaning: Card number the transaction belongs to; used by CBSTM03A to group transactions per card.

key_fields.name: TRNX-REST
key_fields.meaning: Remaining 318 bytes of transaction data (type, category, source, description, amount, merchant, timestamps), stored as a block in the CBSTM03A transaction table.

key_fields.name: TRNX-DESC
key_fields.meaning: Transaction description printed on the statement detail line.

key_fields.name: TRNX-AMT
key_fields.meaning: Signed transaction amount S9(09)V99, printed and summed into the statement total.

observations.text: Same 350-byte content as CVTRA05Y but with the card number moved to the front as part of the key ('Transaction altered Layout for use in reporting'); the two layouts are not interchangeable byte-for-byte.

purpose: COSTM01 defines TRNX-RECORD, a 350-byte transaction layout re-ordered for reporting, with a composite key of card number plus transaction id. It is used by the statement program CBSTM03A to receive records read from TRNXFILE (via CBSTM03B), load them into its per-card transaction table and print description and amount on statements.
